title: Hierarchical Deep Research for Physically Grounded System-Level Materials Design
abstract: arXiv:2511.18303v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Designing multicomponent materials systems requires evidence on composition, interfaces, processing and deviceoperation that is scattered across the literature. Language-model research agents can collect this evidence, but their reports are seldom tested against physics. Here we show that Deep Tree of Research, a hierarchical multi-agent system built on locally deployable open-weight language models, ranks first among 47 agents in blinded evaluationacross 27 nanomaterials and device topics. translated_title: 面向物理约束的系统级材料设计的分层深度研究
translated_abstract: 设计多组分材料系统需要关于成分、界面、加工和器件操作的证据，而这些证据散布于文献之中。语言模型研究智能体能够收集这些证据，但其报告很少经过物理验证。本文展示了Deep Tree of Research（深度研究树）——一个基于可本地部署的开源权重语言模型构建的分层多智能体系统，在涵盖27个纳米材料与器件主题的盲评中，于47个智能体中排名第一。在五项设计任务的十项第一性原理模拟指标中，本地智能体提出的候选方案有九项优于最佳商业系统。在一个传感案例研究中，该智能体为短链污染物全氟戊酸提出了氟化银纳米颗粒/MXene结构；在专家将锚定基团替换为胺基后，所制备的传感器在自来水中表现出选择性和可重复的响应，与界面机制相一致。
tldr: 本文提出基于开源语言模型的分层多智能体系统"Deep Tree of Research"，在盲评中于47个智能体中排名第一，其材料设计方案在第一性原理模拟中超越最佳商业系统，并通过传感器实验得到物理验证。
en_tdlr: A hierarchical multi-agent system built on locally deployable open-weight language models, Deep Tree of Research, ranks first among 47 agents in blinded evaluation, with its materials design candidates outperforming top commercial systems in first-principles simulations and being validated experimentally in sensing applications.
